headline: Shocking scandal! Chabaidao suspected of IPO manipulation and suspended from trading; controlling shareholder made a rushed dividend payout before listing; state-owned shareholding may be key focus of investigation
summary: Chabaidao has been suspended from trading over suspected IPO manipulation. Its controlling shareholder made a rushed dividend payout before listing, and state-owned shareholding may be a focus of the probe.
why: IPO manipulation and undisclosed pre-listing payouts are regulatory issues that can affect investor confidence in new listings and the company's shares.
